# CP9 cross-fork reconciliation

The supplied instruction to intervene during 8.3 is superseded. This reconciliation occurred at the start of CP9, on the exact completed 8.3 candidate. The donor was inspected, not overlaid.

| Item | Disposition | Actual comparison | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| CP8-F01 | adopt | Original target-bound acceptedElevation guard; eight RED tests on 8.3 | Ported invariant and post-admission call, not donor renderer. |
| CP8-F02 | already addressed + adopt bound | 8.3 epoch, current publication checks, discontinuity and hidden/dispose already present; original scheduler tests provide adversarial scenarios | Retain scheduler, adopt 30s age; actual controls pass. High-rate availability is separate OPEN work. |
| CP8-F03 | adopt alternative after measurement | Original refuses physical main-thread fallback; 8.3 synchronous fallback heartbeat2255.5ms | Withdraw optional sky, explicit retry. Matching failure-path heartbeat17.8ms; normal CPU×4 performance remains OPEN. |
| CP8-F04 | compare, retain coherent policy | Exact same CP7 source/basis; factorisation plus both actual native widget screenshots | Neither proxy calibration proved superior. Reject mixing exponent3/6/8, E2, camera325×216/alt25/FOV95, .005lp² outside cloud or physical lunar overrides into current policy. |
| D-05 | adopt with reversible refinement | Original pagehide cleanup; a simple terminal dispose would strand restored pages | Paired generation-fenced suspension and persisted-only resume; first event-order failure preserved. |
| D-06 | adopt | Original explicit single-cloud/engine ownership checks | Native engine refuses second transmission/glow; no change to local-light placement. |
| D-07 | adopt | Original QA join | Add compact realSky to native qaState without mutating existing fields, label old synthetic telemetry. |
| D-08 | adapt and qualify | Original cloud pixel equality fast path | Require exact physical frame + support + mask + PBR + cloud pixels. Fix metadata refresh on skip; moving-Moon/cloud controls retained. |
| D-09 | alternative not adopted | Donor PhysicalSkyBridge.controller.last projection cache | Our actual ResilientPhysicalSkyBridge owns private bridges. Copying one field would not wire reuse; no matched benefit demonstrated. Any justified redesign belongs to the measured residual performance/availability nodes. |
| D-10 | reject as superiority evidence | Donor smaller output/upper viewport and exposure | Different field/raster and retained diagnostic payloads; raw bytes/timing not a like-for-like performance win. No silent reduction of physical field/tier. |
| D-11 | already retained / reject restrictions without evidence | Same admitted catalogue, registered source, spectra and shared science; differing optional date/camera policy | No new dataset in donor. Keep existing admitted time/camera domains, strict estimates and physical-vs-calendar Moon separation; do not impose arbitrary donor restrictions to hide failing scenes. |

Both native baselines match all 162 files. The donor’s 56-file reproducible capsule is hash-pinned to the uploaded donor archive; common scientific dependencies are checked against the immutable CP7.6 reference. The full donor 46-test integration suite and uniform-cloud factorisation are reproducible through `tools/cp9_donor_check.py`. Its standalone widget is a comparison-only entry. Never substitute it for `widget/`.

The coherent retained native operator is gas-transported background plus calendar-masked direct stars/diffuse, native PBR material, then native cloud colour/transmission, then shared display encode. The native inverse-tone colour convention is not a claim of calibrated physical cloud radiance. Exact material/operator preservation supports consistency; it does not prove this empirical cloud model is more physically accurate than the original.

The paired comparison uses the same transported linear fields, camera, source and exposure. With no native colour/local addition, all four matched transmissions give identical encoded output. With native colour and each policy’s meter, the models differ (maximum 64 code values in the retained input). Both actual native candidates were also run at night/cloud/day with their own declared defaults; screenshots expose the difference rather than falsely normalising unrelated cameras/exposures.
